items.Sentence: The WRP will provide treatment with ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection.

The Initial Phase (Phase 1A) of the WRP will consist of an influent pump station, headworks, 60-mil single lined emergency overflow pond with equalization basins, a modular packaged membrane bioreactor (MBR) system designed by Cloacina®, sludge handling facilities, and one percolation pond divided into multiple cells.
The modular packaged MBR system will contain two anoxic basins, three aeration basins, two MBR filters, and a UV disinfection unit.

The Initial Phase (Phase 1A) of the WRP will consist of an influent pump station, headworks, 60-mil single lined emergency overflow pond with equalization basins, a modular packaged membrane bioreactor (MBR) system designed by Cloacina®, sludge handling facilities, and one percolation pond divided into multiple cells.

Wasted sludge will be conveyed to a package Cloacina DRYPAC® aerated sludge handling system, which will consist of an aerated sludge storage tank, dewatering press, polymer system, and associated pumps.
Dewatered sludge will be placed in bins and transported off-site for disposal at a permitted landfill or land application area.
For Phase 1A, disposal of treated effluent will be to onsite percolation ponds only.
The WRP will provide treatment that will include nitrification/denitrification to reduce nitrogen concentrations in the effluent to less than 10 mg/L.
